notes.text: May I, then, suggest five reasons why all of us, rich or poor, [CR, 40] longtime member or newest convert, should faithfully pay our tithes and offerings 1) To teach your children and grandchildren 2) To claim the Lord's promised blessings 3) To keep material possessions in perspective 4) To give God His rightful due 5) To express love to God …I testify that the principle of tithing is of God, taught to us in such scriptural simplicity that we cannot doubt its divinity. (Jeffrey R. Holland, Ensign, Nov. 2001, 33-35) [His talk illustrates each of these points]
